name: Khemani Distributors & Marketing Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Khemani Distributors & Marketing Ltd trades in HUL's FMCG products and Shares & Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KDML is in the business of Trading in FMCG products of Hindustan Unilever as a Redistribution Stockiest in Surat, Gujarat. 
Company also deals in Stock Market in Securities and other Financial Products

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 24.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 76.4 days to 29.2 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 30.2% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.8.33 Cr.
